# Urban Reach

> Commercial appliance supplier in Austin, Texas. Urban Reach sources, delivers, and installs commercial-grade appliance packages for general contractors, architects, designers, and developers across Central Texas.

## What we do

- Review appliance and equipment schedules against project specifications
- Source and price appliances from manufacturer partners, with itemized pricing a GC can present to the client
- Deliver and install on site, coordinated with the build sequence, under one point of contact
- Verify existing conditions on tenant improvements before ordering

## Projects we work on

Multifamily developments, office buildouts, tenant improvements, and interior finish work. No minimum project size or order quantity.

## Appliance categories

Refrigeration, dishwashers, beverage equipment, cooking appliances, and specialty or made-to-spec equipment.

## Brands

Authorized dealer for Samsung, Summit, GE Appliances (a Haier company), Fisher & Paykel, Champion, and BUNN. Other manufacturers sourced on request.

## Who we work with

Primarily general contractors. Also architects, designers, developers, and commercial property owners.

## Where we work

Austin, TX and surrounding Central Texas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Bee Cave, West Lake Hills, Manchaca, and East Austin.

## Hours

Monday-Friday 8am-5pm.

## How to start

Send the appliance or equipment schedule, relevant plan sheets, and the build sequence.
